analysis: The PR change visible here is a CHANGELOG.md-only edit: a new 'Unreleased — personal data in coordinator logs' entry at lines 3-5 (head side). It says the coordinator stops writing emails, client IPs, device serials and MDA UDIDs to process logs, which go to Datadog. It also says the access log drops its `remote` field and the MDM webhook debug line drops its body preview. No source code was supplied in the patch, so none of these claims could be verified against code. The change is documentation only and adds no new attack surface. It is directionally privacy-positive and relates to T-051, T-058 and the privacy-related notes on TB-002/TB-011. One caveat for the next pass: the threat model header says App Attest account/machine/credential IDs still enter operational logs and Datadog. The entry says accounts and providers are now named by account_id and provider_id, which is consistent with that. If the accompanying code changes live in other units not supplied here, a reviewer should confirm that the removal of the access-log `remote` field does not weaken rate-limiting, abuse attribution or repudiation mitigations for T-005 and T-006, which may rely on IP in logs. A threat-model update may also be warranted to record the log-PII posture. Coverage limit: the source changes behind this changelog were not part of this batch, so the claims are unverified. I do not consider that a finding.
